# The Symbolic World

> A verified knowledge graph of C. G. Jung's Collected Works. Each relation between two concepts cites a volume and paragraph of the Collected Works with a short verbatim quote, and records the checks the claim passed.

## Pages

- [Method](https://symbolicworld.observer/method): how a claim gets into the graph, and what the checks do and do not cover
- [Concepts](https://symbolicworld.observer/concepts): every concept in the graph, with its relations and citations counted
- Concept pages: https://symbolicworld.observer/concept-<id>, one per concept, for example https://symbolicworld.observer/concept-anima

## Data

- [The dataset](https://symbolicworld.observer/graph.json): the whole graph as one JSON file
- [The RDF export](https://symbolicworld.observer/vocabulary#export): the graph as Turtle files with PROV-O provenance and no quotations, served from this site and carried by each release on the Zenodo record https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21631523

## Licence

- The structure, relations, claim typing and metadata are under CC BY 4.0. That grant does not cover the verbatim quotations from the Collected Works, which remain with their rights holders.
